description.value: The Hornby Island Co-op has been the social and economic heart of the island since 1955, operating as a community-owned co-operative offering groceries, hardware, a gas bar, a post office, and a Ringside Market hosting small local vendors. A deli counter runs a hot lunch program, making this a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists arriving by ferry. The co-op is currently undergoing a building update as of May 2026, with all departments remaining in operation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, multi-department co-operative at this location with grocery, hardware, gas bar, post office, and a deli featuring a 'hot lunch program' (per the employment page listing for Senior Deli Clerk). The store phone number 250-335-1121 and website URL are corroborated by the website footer. No mention of bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, racks, charging) appears anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: Website footer notes 'Building Update - May 2026' and Gas Bar is listed with a 'Temporary Number: 250-335-2423', suggesting active construction; OSM record and primary store number appear unaffected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible co-operative grocery and general store that is the primary community hub on Hornby Island — clearly useful to touring cyclists as a resupply point.

Hot food.detail: Employment page describes a Senior Deli Clerk role responsible for 'the hot lunch program', indicating prepared hot food is sold in-store

wow_evidence: community-owned co-operative... social and economic heart of the island since 1955
